attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation is valid for row-normal occurrence-local transcripts; full EF+SAT_U may use real SAT syntax to create nonrelativizing dependencies not represented by Q_pi.
steps: Parse pi into Q_pi by listing occurrence labels, extension equations, rule justifications, and explicit complete-row parity nodes; this is independent of the desired lower bound.
For x not in ForcedRows(pi), flip or set y_{x,j} privately so xor_j y_{x,j}=0 while preserving all row-normal dependencies appearing in Q_pi.
Define spoofed carrier H^A to be zero off ForcedRows(pi); equality gates patch the forced rows, giving size O(|ForcedRows(pi)|N)+N^{o(1)}.
Functional soundness would accept pi for H^A, so if |ForcedRows(pi)|<N^{epsilon-o(1)} it certifies hardness for an easy function, contradiction.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This proves a scoped method-class no-go, not P != NP. Promotion requires either proving every intended EF+SAT_U transcript has row-normal extraction or explicitly restricting the theorem statement.

assumptions: Model is row-normal EF+SAT_U^{occ}: any parity-sensitive complete-row dependency must be exposed by an inspectable row-parity node.
Functional soundness ranges over all occurrence-label assignments satisfying Q_pi, not only over the real SAT labeling.
Private labels may be changed independently on unforced rows while preserving every parsed line of pi.
The claimed source lower bound is C(H_N)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} in unrestricted nonuniform circuits on N-bit source inputs.
definitions: source object: a row-normal EF+SAT_U^{occ} transcript pi for H_N(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with occurrence labels y_{x,j}.
target object: a scoped no-go theorem for proof-mediated beta-zero XOR certificates, not a proof of P != NP.
controlled interface: beta-zero compact generator, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, L_N=(log N)^d, overhead N^{rho+o(1)}, and occurrence-local proof access.
target-preserving condition: q,rho<1+epsilon and the parser/spoof construction uses no SAT-circuit advice, so the valid target transfer remains unchanged.
Q_pi is the finite dependency graph of occurrence labels, extension definitions, and explicit row-parity forcing declarations parsed from pi.
ForcedRows(pi) is the syntactically inspectable set of x whose full row parity xor_j y_{x,j} is declared or derived in row-normal form.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: RowSyntaxRealizability(E_full): prove that every private perturbation outside charged complete rows is realizable by a valid full EF+SAT_U shared formula-DAG assignment, or exhibit the exact shared dependency that must be charged.
steps: Start from the cycle-81 EF+SAT_U^{occ} theorem: row-view-sound accepted transcripts either force N^{epsilon-o(1)} private complete rows or admit a sparse-row spoof circuit.
Attempt to interpret each full EF+SAT_U SAT_U call as a private occurrence label and reuse the private perturbation A_Q outside ForcedRows(pi).
Define Q_pi as the visible proof-view atoms, row indices, formula-bit labels, and SAT_U argument occurrences extracted from pi.
Try to preserve the accepted transcript under A_Q by changing unforced row labels while leaving Q_pi fixed.
The preservation step needs a full-syntax realization sigma_A satisfying all extension equations for G_N and all equality/substitution rules used by pi.
A finite shared-DAG fragment e1=e2=y blocks this step: A_Q may flip e1 but not e2, which is allowed in the occurrence model but impossible in full EF+SAT_U.
Therefore TouchedRows(pi) and private ForcedRows_occ(pi) are not target-preserving complete rows in full syntax unless a row-syntax extractor charges every visible cross-row dependency.
If such an extractor E_full exists and satisfies RowSep(pi,R_pi), the occurrence theorem plus sparse patching gives |R_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)}.
No proof of RowSep for standard full EF+SAT_U and the actual generator syntax is currently available; the valid theorem remains restricted to EF+SAT_U^{occ}.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a proof-quality boundary packet, not a P != NP proof. The occurrence-local theorem is valid in the restricted model, but full EF+SAT_U transfer is blocked at formula-syntax extraction rather than at generic natural-proofs folklore.

assumptions: The beta-zero XOR carrier has M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, formula length L_N=(log N)^d, and generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
The source lower-bound claim under audit is C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} for a named nonuniform circuit model with row lookup patch cost O(N).
The occurrence-local ForcedRows theorem is valid only in EF+SAT_U^{occ}, where private-label perturbations preserve accepted transcripts outside charged rows.
The full extractor must be uniform or advice-free at the proof-parser level; nonuniform row advice is counted as leakage and cannot certify target-preserving transfer.
Soundness used for the lift must be row-view soundness or DirectClusterSound, not ordinary local consistency alone.
definitions: source object: a full EF+SAT_U proof transcript pi for H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), where full means SAT_U arguments are real formulas or extension-DAG nodes, not private occurrence labels.

target object: a scoped row-forcing no-go theorem saying any sound beta-zero XOR certificate either forces |R_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} complete rows or admits a sparse-row spoof/patch circuit below the claimed source lower bound.

controlled interface: a syntactic parser E_full(pi) producing Q_pi, the shared dependency hypergraph Dep_pi, complete forced rows R_pi, and the allowed perturbation family A_Q without using the target lower bound as an oracle.

target-preserving condition: every charged row j must correspond to the length-N row function R_j(x)=SAT(G_N(x,j)), the patch cost must be O(N) per charged row, and every perturbation outside R_pi must satisfy all full EF extension and substitution equations.
EF+SAT_U^{occ}: the restricted model in which each SAT_U occurrence carries a private label and occurrence-local rules cannot compare labels except through the accepted view.

full EF+SAT_U: extended Frege plus a universal SAT predicate over actual formula encodings, with equality, substitution, and shared extension definitions enforcing consistency between repeated subformulas.
complete row: the whole truth table x -> SAT(G_N(x,j)) for a fixed j, not a single touched SAT_U argument or formula bit.

candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Primary boundary lemma for the proof-delivery queue: it separates the already scoped EF+SAT_U^{occ} no-go from any claimed full EF+SAT_U theorem.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For the beta-zero XOR carrier, the EF+SAT_U^{occ} ForcedRows theorem lifts to full EF+SAT_U only under a row-syntax-realizability extractor. The extractor must turn a full transcript pi into complete forced rows R_pi such that private perturbations outside R_pi are realizable by valid shared formula syntax. Without this extractor, shared-DAG equality is a finite falsifier to the occurrence-local invariance step.

assumptions: The parser computes B_pi syntactically from the transcript and generator encoding in time polynomial in |pi| and N^{o(1)} parser overhead.
Each charged boundary element is a complete generated row, not a subformula occurrence, so the patch inequality remains valid.
The proof rules in full EF+SAT_U respect extension-DAG equality and substitution, and all such equalities are represented in Dep_pi.
definitions: source object: full EF+SAT_U transcript pi with dependency hypergraph Dep_pi over extension nodes, SAT_U arguments, row indices, and proof-view atoms.
target object: the EF+SAT_U^{occ} row-forcing theorem lifted to full EF+SAT_U for the same beta-zero XOR carrier.
bridge observable: a row boundary B_pi such that all cross-row shared extension nodes incident to the proof view are charged to B_pi.
row-separated outside B_pi: no extension node appearing in the accepted view can constrain SAT_U arguments from two uncharged distinct rows.

equations.label: row_separation_condition
equations.latex: u\in R_j,\ v\in R_{j'},\ \mathrm{Dep}(u)\cap \mathrm{Dep}(v)\cap \mathrm{View}(\pi)\ne\emptyset\Rightarrow j=j'\ \text{or}\ j,j'\in B_\pi.
equations.valid_when: Valid when Dep records all shared formula and extension dependencies visible to the full EF+SAT_U transcript.

equations.label: conditional_lift
equations.latex: \mathrm{RowSep}(\pi,B_\pi)\ \wedge\ \mathrm{DCS}(\pi)\Rightarrow |B_\pi|\ge N^{\epsilon-o(1)}\ \text{or sparse patch falsifies the certificate}.
equations.valid_when: Applies when DirectClusterSound supplies usefulness and B_pi consists of complete rows with O(N) patch cost.

Then every occurrence-private perturbation outside R_pi is realized by a full-syntax assignment, and the sparse patch threshold remains target-preserving.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: Full EF+SAT_U may encode real formula identity, sharing, or substitution congruence that creates cross-occurrence constraints absent from Q_pi; the occurrence-local parser must either record them or the theorem cannot cover full EF+SAT_U.
steps: Parse pi line by line into Q_pi: every oracle atom becomes an occurrence variable; every local premise becomes a constraint; explicit copied labels are edges, while unmentioned formula equality is deliberately absent.

Induct on EF+SAT_U^{occ} rules. Because each rule verifier reads only parsed occurrence labels and local clauses, any A in LocSat(Q_pi) makes the same transcript locally valid; this proves private-label invariance for the restricted Psys.

If x is not in F(Q_pi), choose A,A' in LocSat(Q_pi) with opposite row XOR. Invariance keeps pi accepted under both, so a certificate claiming a fixed row parity for x is not row-parity binding; this is the spoof falsifier.

For rows outside F(Q_pi) union R_pi, use the low adaptive-cover decoder; patch F(Q_pi) union R_pi by lookup rows and add generator overhead. This gives the displayed upper bound and threshold collapse test.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a restricted-model route falsifier, not P != NP. It becomes paper-ready only after the rule list for EF+SAT_U^{occ} is fixed and the full EF+SAT_U extraction boundary is separately proved or quarantined.

assumptions: Psys is equality-free EF+SAT_U^{occ}: rule checking can inspect occurrence names and parsed local clauses, but cannot compare unparsed real SAT formulas extensionally.
Row-parity binding is semantic over LocSat(Q_pi): an accepted certificate claiming row bit b for x is valid only if every A in LocSat(Q_pi) gives parity b for x.
The low-cover decoder computes certified parities outside F(Q_pi) union R_pi with size N^{q+alpha_ad+o(1)} and uses no advice depending on a hard row selector.
Let |F(Q_pi)|<=N^{f+o(1)} and |R_pi|<=N^{r+o(1)}; patching a row costs O(N^{1+o(1)}) gates in the target unrestricted circuit model.
definitions: source object: accepted equality-free EF+SAT_U^{occ} transcript pi for H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), with M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
target object: scoped route-specific no-go theorem: low-cover proof-mediated beta-zero XOR certificates cannot certify C(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} when the patch exponent is below 1+epsilon.
controlled interface: parser pi -> Q_pi, LocSat(Q_pi), ForcedRows F(Q_pi), residual set R_pi, and adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ad for opening certificate-controlled row parities.

target-preserving condition: same N and same unrestricted circuit target are used; G_N is uniform, occurrence labels are not advice-selected hard rows, and row patches are charged in the same nonuniform circuit model.
Q_pi records exactly the SAT_U occurrence atoms, local rule premises, claimed row parities, and explicit occurrence equalities present in pi.
LocSat(Q_pi) is the set of private Boolean labelings of parsed occurrences satisfying all local constraints and containing the true SAT labeling as a valid member.
F(Q_pi) consists of complete rows whose XOR parity is constant over LocSat(Q_pi), not rows merely mentioned by the transcript.

equations.label: forced_rows

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Find an allowed rule whose verification uses formula identity or extensional SAT equality not recorded in Q_pi; then private-label invariance fails and the theorem must remain restricted.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Discharges the parser-invariance sublemma for equality-free occurrence-local certificates and names the exact boundary before any full EF+SAT_U promotion.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For equality-free EF+SAT_U^{occ}, an accepted transcript pi is invariant under every private occurrence-label assignment in LocSat(Q_pi). Hence valid row-parity binding forces certified rows into F(Q_pi); small F plus low adaptive cover yields a patch upper bound, while nonforced rows give a spoof falsifier.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot only if EF+SAT_U^{occ} rule induction fails without yielding a smaller rule-level countermodel.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote after a formal rule list proves invariance, LocSat nonemptiness, patch accounting, and a separate full EF+SAT_U boundary statement.
control_decision.reason: The restricted theorem is now derivable modulo a fixed rule list, and the remaining gap is a named extraction boundary rather than broad MCSP exploration.

dependency_updates.description: Parser pi->Q_pi is now theorem-shaped for equality-free occurrence-local rules; it defines ForcedRows without referencing the desired lower bound.
Invariance follows by rule induction only if formula identity is not consulted; otherwise congruence becomes the smallest countermodel family.
Upper bound now charges forced rows by f as well as residual rows by r: exponent max{rho,q+alpha_ad,max(f,r)+1}.
Check definitions of LocSat nonemptiness, equality-free rules, row patch cost, and target unrestricted-circuit identity.

falsifiers: If LocSat(Q_pi) is empty, ForcedRows is vacuous; the parser must prove the true SAT labeling is a valid member before using constancy.
An allowed congruence rule comparing G_N(x,j) and G_N(x',j') outside occurrence names breaks private-label invariance and falsifies the equality-free theorem scope.
If alpha_ad or max(f,r)+1 reaches 1+epsilon, the patch bound is not subthreshold and gives no contradiction to the claimed lower bound.
If the claimed consequence is only uniform hardness, the nonuniform row patch is not a valid refutation; the target model must be unrestricted circuits.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: As f crosses 1+epsilon-1, the patch term changes from a valid lower-bound falsifier to a harmless upper bound; below the threshold, nonforced rows admit private-label spoofing.
held_fixed_controls: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)} and generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)} are fixed.
Adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ad and residual exponent r are fixed.
The true SAT labeling is required to lie in LocSat(Q_pi).
No rule may compare real SAT formulas except through parsed occurrence labels.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The live gap is not another barrier slogan but whether private occurrence labels really create a spoof or a patch circuit in the named Psys.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Fix a padded SAT-query family G_N and an equality-free EF+SAT_U^{occ} transcript pi whose local constraints touch all certificate labels but leave most complete XOR rows privately assignable.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal parser theorem proving Q_pi completeness for the restricted rule list, plus an extraction boundary showing which full EF+SAT_U rules add nonlocal constraints.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 82 moves the ForcedRows packet from semantic intuition to a restricted proof fork: equality-free occurrence-local certificates have private-label invariance, so valid row-parity binding forces syntactic row constancy. The exact escape is nonlocal formula identity in full EF+SAT_U.

negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: Private occurrence-label assignments and sparse row patches showing that nonforced rows are not semantically bound.
escape_conditions: explicit advice-free row-hard certificate for each certified complete row
searchable certificate within EF+SAT_U or a fixed stronger Psys rule list
density and forced-row control avoiding natural-property largeness and selector advice

negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send to pvsnp-forcedrows-proof-workflow for rule induction, then to pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor for exponent and patch validation.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: Potential scoped theorem: an occurrence-local ForcedRows no-go plus an explicit full EF+SAT_U extraction boundary; not a proof of P != NP.

Prove LocSat(Q_pi) contains the true SAT labeling and that ForcedRows is syntactically inspectable.
Check whether selection uses advice, ranking, real-formula equality, or nonuniform hard-string choice.
Test easy sparse tables, private-label spoofs, and low-complexity row patches as falsifiers.
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: The carrier may certify only occurrence-local aggregate consistency, not advice-free row hardness; private-label spoofing tests that failure directly.
